resources.string: Lets your paired Allternit Desktop use the apps on this phone.

Allternit Phone Link reads what is on screen and taps and types for your own paired computer, so Allternit bots can use the apps you are already signed in to (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Telegram and others). It never acts on the lock screen, in Settings or in this app, and you can stop it any time from its notification. If you turn on \"Offer help when an app shows an error\" in Phone Link, it also reads error dialogs on this phone to offer help; that text stays on the phone until you send it.

Allternit Phone Link uses Android's Accessibility service so that your own paired computer, Allternit bots you run there, and a viewer you allow in your Allternit account can use the apps on this phone.

What it does: it taps, swipes and types, and presses Back, Home and Recent apps, for them. It never acts on the lock screen, in Settings or in this app.

What it reads: what is on screen in the app being used, so a bot can find buttons and text. If you turn on Error help, it also reads error dialogs to offer help; that text stays on the phone until you send it. Password fields are never read.

Where it goes: only to your own paired computer or your Allternit account, over an encrypted connection. We do not sell it or share it with anyone else.

You can turn it off any time in Settings › Accessibility › Allternit Phone Link, or tap Stop in its notification.
